# stb_truetype

`stb_truetype.h` v1.26 by Sean Barrett, from https://github.com/nothings/stb
at commit `6e9f34d5429cf16790ec43c9bac3f1ee4ad1f760` (the last change to the
file), unmodified. sha256
`ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab`.

Used by `src/model/coverfont.cpp` to draw the titles of the bootleg cover art
the same way on the build host (tests, font samples) and on both AROS ABIs.
The file is dual-licensed (MIT or public domain); this project uses the MIT
alternative, `LICENSES/MIT-stb.txt`.
